verdict.rationale: CRA documents EFILE as a sanctioned software-transmitter channel. Developers certify their tax software with the CRA, and enrolled electronic filers transmit client returns from that certified software. Filers use an EFILE number and password to maintain and renew their account and view transmission history, and ReFILE handles amended returns. The agency's own page is said to publish the enrollment path. Missing for 10: verbatim enrollment and application steps (only maintain/renew is quoted), evidence of system accounts or batch/bulk channels beyond T1 EFILE (e.g., payroll or information-return transmitters), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
